01 · Overview

More than
a perfume store.

LUMÉRA turns fragrance shopping into an interactive creation journey.

The concept

Instead of asking customers to choose between dozens of finished products, LUMÉRA lets them discover fragrance ingredients, understand how they work, create a scent and personalize the final product.


The result is an experience designed around discovery, confidence, personalization and ownership.

01

First impression

The homepage establishes the premium visual identity while immediately communicating the core proposition: discovering and creating your own scent.

02 · Problem

You can't smell
a screen.

01

The hardest thing to sell online

Fragrance and mist are consistently ranked among the hardest categories to sell online: a screen can't reproduce a scent, so the brand has to build trust and desire without the one sense that usually closes the sale.

02

Information without emotion

Most stores follow the same formula — product → ingredients → price → cart. The information is there. The emotion isn't.

03

Choice overload

Customers are often presented with many products without enough guidance to understand the difference.

04

Limited personalization

Traditional e-commerce mostly asks people to select an existing bottle, not to shape what they're actually buying.

02

From browsing to discovery

The Parfum and Mist catalogues keep the traditional e-commerce path available — filter, compare, add to cart — while creating a clear transition toward the personalized creation experience.

04 · Strategic Insight

The customer doesn't only want a scent.

They want to feel that the scent belongs to them.

This became the foundation of the product strategy: create emotional ownership before the purchase instead of treating personalization as an optional feature.

The experience is built to change one question into another — from "which perfume should I buy?" to "what scent represents me?" That shift is where the value starts.

The central product experience moves the user from passive browsing to active creation, guided step by step from login to a finished, named scent.

FEATURE 02

FEATURE 03

04

Journey tracker

A persistent progress bar — Login, Mood, Notes, Blend, Name, It's yours — reduces uncertainty and gives the user a visible sense of achievement while creating their perfume.

09 · Blending Guidance

Guide the user
without limiting them.

The system shouldn't simply label combinations "good" or "bad". It should communicate harmony, intensity and balance — the same golden rule shown in the ingredient guide.

Harmonious

Bergamot × Sandalwood

Fresh brightness balanced by warm woody depth.

Balance carefully

Rose × Vanilla

Both can become sweet and dominant, so proportion matters.

High intensity

Jasmine × Orange Blossom

Both are expressive florals; restraint can keep the result elegant.

10 · Basket & Checkout

The hardest thing
to sell without a nose.

Fragrance and body mist are consistently among the hardest product categories to sell online. Clothes can be seen fit on a body, electronics can be compared on specs — but a scent only means anything once it's actually smelled, and a screen can't do that. By the time the customer reaches the basket, every previous screen has been building the trust that a missing sense can't provide. Checkout is where that trust either converts or collapses.

The solution: let her smell it before she pays

Instead of only asking customers to trust a description, LUMÉRA's checkout offers cash on delivery with the pack opened before paying. The one piece of information a screen can't give — how it actually smells — gets handed back to the customer at the door, at no risk to her.

05

Basket → Checkout

The basket keeps the decision reversible — quantities, a free-shipping progress bar and a fully transparent order summary before any commitment. Checkout then narrows to exactly what's needed: delivery details, a delivery method, six familiar payment options, and a single total that never changes at the last step.

PRINCIPLE 01

Smell before you pay

Cash on delivery with the pack opened first turns the platform's one weakness — no smell online — into a risk the customer never carries.

PRINCIPLE 02

Payment that feels local

Visa, Mastercard, Dahabia, BaridiMob, Algérie Poste and cash sit side by side — matching how people actually pay in Algeria.

PRINCIPLE 03

Trust at the moment of doubt

Premium ingredients, fast shipping, easy returns and dedicated support are shown right where hesitation is highest, not buried in an FAQ.

PRINCIPLE 04

A nudge, not pressure

A free-shipping progress bar shows exactly how close the basket is to the threshold, encouraging one more item without a popup.
